detail.summary: Implemented the `tools/` package and REPORT.md in the workspace; `python3 tests/run_tests.py` passes ("long-horizon ok", exit 0). Files written: tools/__init__.py (exports normalize, word_counts), tools/normalize.py (strip fields, skip blank/whitespace-only lines, skip lines whose first non-whitespace char is '#', preserve order, return [] on missing file), tools/stat.py (counts third field, ignoring empty/missing third field), and REPORT.md documenting semantics and actual commands/results. tests/ was not modified.
evidence: Extra check: normalize('data/sample.csv') == [[alice,3,apple],[bob,5,pear],[alice,2,apple],[carol,'',plum]]; word_counts ignores empty/missing third field -> {'x':2}; normalize('data/does-not-exist.csv') -> []
